"''I'll be as quick as I can.|Deena Lorn and Tig|}} '''Tig''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] [[stormtrooper]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. She was knocked off a platform in the [[Cloud City]] [[carbon-freezing chamber]] by the [[Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca]] before [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]] was frozen in [[carbonite]], though she was unharmed. ==Biography== {{Quote|Damn thing got busted in the fall. Safety's jammed.|Tig, to Deena Lorn|}} During the [[Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]], the [[human]] [[Gender|female]] Tig served as an Imperial [[stormtrooper]] in the Empire's [[501st Legion]], the personal [[legion]] of the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].''[[Battlefront: Twilight Company]]'' She was part of a [[Deena Lorn's fireteam|fireteam]] with fellow [[trooper]]s [[Ella]], [[Riccarn]], [[Xander]] and [[Deena Lorn]], which endured a number of missions together, leading to their eventual reassignment with a [[Deena's squad|squad]] aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]]''[[Ultimate Star Wars]]'' ''[[Executor]]'', Vader's [[flagship]]. Aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer]], Tig spent some nights with her [[squad]]mates in a corner of the ''Executor''{{'s}} mess hall, excluding their squadmate [[FS-451]]. Sipping illegal [[alcohol]] distilled by Xander, the troopers questioned why 451 had not been promoted from stormtrooper, Tig claiming that the stormtrooper had wanted to become a [[death trooper]]. [[File:TigToss-TESB.png|thumb|left|300px|Tig was unable to subdue the enraged Chewbacca.]] In [[3 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' the ''Executor'' traveled to the [[tibanna]] [[gas]] [[mining]] colony [[Cloud City]] in the [[Bespin system]]. After Vader captured a group of rebel fugitives in the [[city]], the [[Sith]] [[Lord]] arranged for one of the rebels, [[Captain]] [[Han Solo]], to be frozen in Cloud City's [[carbon-freezing chamber]].{{Film|V}} With Lorn and FS-451 already deployed with Vader, Tig traveled by [[shuttle]] to Cloud City and joined his two squadmates in a complement of stormtroopers overseeing the freezing of Solo. Vader ordered for Solo to be put in the chamber, prompting the captain's [[Wookiee]] companion [[Chewbacca]] to throw two troopers over the edge of their platform. Tig rushed towards the Wookiee, who threw her over the ledge before he was finally calmed by Solo. Tig survived her fall unharmed, but her [[Stormtrooper armor|armor]] covered in grease. Her [[E-11 medium blaster rifle]]'s safety was also jammed in the process. After Solo was frozen, Lorn left her post and went down to Tig, who explained her damaged [[blaster rifle]]. Lorn then offered to give Tig her own E-11, promising to swap the damaged one out for a working on at an armory. Tig agreed and the pair swapped [[blaster]]s and parted ways. However, Lorn instead deserted the Empire thereafter and took Tig's broken blaster [[rifle]] with her. ==Equipment== Tig wore the standard [[armor]] of an Imperial stormtrooper, carrying an E-11 blaster rifle. ==Behind the scenes== Tig first appeared in the [[Irvin Kershner]]'s [[1980]] film {{Film|V}}, played by an uncredited extra. She was identified in the short story "[[The Witness]]," which was written by [[Adam Christopher]] and released as part of ''[[From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back]]'', a short story collection published in celebration of 40 years of ''The Empire Strikes Back''. ==Appearances== {{IncompleteList}} {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Tig}} *{{Film|V}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back'' Screen Comix]] *{{StoryCite|story=The Witness|book=From a Certain Point of View: The Empire Strikes Back|audiobook=1}} {{1stID|Tig}} *[[Darth Vader (2020) 12|''Darth Vader'' (2020) 12]] {{Flash}} ==Sources== *''[[Under the Helmet: The Legacy of Boba Fett]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Members of Deena Lorn's fireteam]]
